name: Deferred SDF Rendering
definition: A rendering technique where Signed Distance Fields (SDFs) are rendered to a G-buffer during a pre-pass, decoupling the SDF geometry generation from the lighting calculations to reduce shader cost and register pressure.
summary: Deferred SDF Rendering decouples geometry generation from lighting via a G-buffer pre-pass, enabling SDFs to participate in deferred post-processing effects while sacrificing high-quality SDF-specific reflections and shadows.
